reference/faust-warp-train-dialogue.content:
Faust Dialogue — Murder on the WARP Express (Intervallo IV)
Year: 984-11 | Episodes 1-14


Dante, please respond. There’s—


Dante, I understand your considerable degree of disorientation, but—


Your alarmed response and possible incompliance have already been accounted for.


Faust has indeed known this all along, as no knowledge is out of Faust’s reach. As expected, a solution to your dilemma has already been prepared.


The rearmost tail cars of WARP trains are all freight cars. That is where Mephistopheles will be safely fastened and transported.


And the LCB will…


… have the benefit of boarding as first class passengers.


The company’s budget is not a subject that warrants your concern.


That is the promotional language, yes. They are flash-freeze hibernation capsules, to be precise.


They have been designed to easily withstand the ‘true’ amount of time it takes for the WARP train to travel from point A to point B. The trip will be over in the blink of an eye for the passengers.


… Yes.


Dante, let us proceed this way.


Please elaborate on your exact definition of ‘safe’.


A flash-freeze hibernation device will put you in a temporary state of death caused by rapid cellular cryopreservation process. However, the rapidity of the process prevents damage to your cells during the phase change. Therefore, in most normal cases, this will not cause any issues.


Faust is aware that this model has fully resolved cell membrane-breaching issues caused by cryogenic density change or by ice crystal growths of hydrogen molecules.


Yes, as far as Faust is aware. Even if an issue were to arise during the journey, because everyone will be reverted to their states at the beginning of the train trip upon arrival, there won’t be any lasting complications from the said problem.


Indeed. As Faust’s talents are not limited to a singular field.


As a general rule, Faust does not err. However, Faust is also not a divine being.


There are certain information in the world that Faust is yet to have access to. Therefore, while Faust may speak the facts, what is said may not always align with the truth.


In order to prevent cases of unnecessary anxiety and misgivings among the Sinners, the history of accidents that has occurred aboard WARP trains will not be shared.


Then, let us hurry and enter our capsules before it is too late.


Is it anxiety, Dante?


Allow me to assist you. Stand as though you are leaning back, and…


Do not worry too much.


… We will meet again in but a moment, Dante.


Dante, you must wake up. Dante—


… An inconceivable situation has occurred.


No, we are not yet at our destination.


Yes.


… I believe we are currently stranded in an unidentified dimension. Coordinates: unknown.


………….


You are half correct, yet half incorrect.


Dante. I understand your confusion, however… perhaps an elaboration of our present circumstance is necessary.


Thank you. Then…


The Distortions themselves likely did not pose a problem for W Corp. Based on the available information, it can be determined that they would have all been neutralized as soon as the train arrived, and any transformed passengers would have been reverted to their human forms.


But…


That is the question for which we must discover the precise cause and effect of.


… That appears to be the most prominent cause of this misunderstanding.


However, we were given this master keycard that can open and close the hibernation capsules at will.


We may return to our respective capsules as soon as the contract is fulfilled and safely complete the rest of the journey as we had planned from the beginning.


That is…


… Next time, I will take your inputs into account.


… That, is something I must first discuss with Dante.


We must converse in a lower volume, Dante.


… My connection to Gesellschaft… I mean, Faust, has been severed.


I… cannot access Faust’s knowledge at the moment.


I mean it in the most literal sense. My access to Faust’s input and information, which has always been readily available… is completely severed.


One cannot completely dismiss that possibility, but even that is… uncertain…


Yes. At this moment, I am… limited to operating only with my knowledge.


I cannot discern the cause of this disconnection… More than enough precautions have likely been taken in case of interdimensional travel, but perhaps Faust did not take into account an occasion in which we may have to access an unidentified dimension such as this. Or, even if it was taken into account, this particular dimension may not yet have been subject to cross-observation.


If that is not the case, then I-no, nevermind.


There was nothing that suggested that my connection to Faust would be lost, not even as we boarded the train. To be honest, this is…


… a rather disagreeable situation for me.


… Understood.


And… to the Sinners…


… the fact that we are currently confined to a WARP train in operation must be a source of enough stress. I believe that sharing Faust’s current state with them would add an unnecessary source of tension.


In the grand scheme of things, yes.


By A Corp.’s standard time scale, approximately three days have passed since our departure.


As per the contract between Limbus Company and W Corp., I acquired the master keycard placed inside my capsule and adjusted the hatch settings to open automatically in three days.


As you were all informed prior to boarding, there is no way for the economy class passengers to enter the first class car; that is why this place has remained untouched.


However, cross-referencing my own deductions and W Corp.’s rather fragmentary explanations, I can assume that ‘the situation’ is currently under progress in the economy class cars.


Precisely. In my opinion, it is—


Please step aside for a moment, Don Quixote. It would be best if I observed it with my own eyes.


I intend to follow your usual flavor of suggestion, Heathcliff.


That there are times in which a physical altercation is preferable to detached ruminations.


After all… how could I deduce anything without seeing it myself?


… Don Quixote.


They are not dead.


Observe closer. The parts are all tethered to one another by something, are they not?


It appears that the flow of time has ceased in this space. Therefore, it follows that the… connections, that tether bodies to life and away from death, remain intact.


Yes. That is a most rational suggestion, Yi Sang.


If their severed parts are all connected… then it can be said that no matter how entangled their bodies become, it is not impossible to eventually gather their parts together to form a single passenger.


Thus, naturally, we can determine how and why the profession ‘W Corp. Cleanup Agent’ has come to be.


Dante.


… Indeed. I intend to collect further intelligence.


Are they Distortions, or… Abnormalities?


Is it difficult to be certain at the moment?


Faust may know… but I, at this moment, have no way of knowing.


There is no need, Dante.


Though the information you have provided me is rather ambiguous, it has helped me deduce something of worth.


And…


Collecting intelligence myself and creating deductions based on sparse information is quite…


… She appeared without warning.


Have you not left this car for the duration of the ride, Sasha?


Hasn’t something else of note also occurred?


… You have decided to protect them, despite the potential risk that they may transform as well.


… I see.


W Corp. has hired us to solve this case. We are…


Um…


Indeed… Fixers.


As you must be well aware yourself, contracts and contract fulfillment are of paramount importance for Fixers.


With that in mind, please recall that W Corp. is one of the most secretive Wings of the City.


This is the master keycard given to us by W Corp. I believe that it can open most doors aboard this train.


It is fortunate that someone like yourself is aboard the train. Your presence ensured that child’s survival.


Be like… what?


Eyes…


I have one last thing to inquire.


… That is quite an unsound decision to make for someone who claims to be ‘in the same line of work’ as us.


Have you considered the possibility that, once our contract is successfully completed, we could include references to a particularly cooperative Associate Office in our report to W Corp?


Were the eyes of the monsters you faced red, by any chance?


No, well.


It was a question of no significance.


Those entities are…


… What do you think those entities are?


Yes, and? Was there anything else?


Thank you, all. Your input has all been very helpful.


We are in luck, Dante.


I have read upon this subject as a tangent while perusing information regarding our next destination, moments before we boarded the train. And while that will be a useful element in resolving this situation…


… the Sinners have also been a very good source of intelligence when it came to categorizing and identifying important evidence from the available sea of information. Your advice was correct, Dante.


Nothing can be said with absolute certainty at the moment. However, this will be a good place for us to start.


… I will now present before you a solution to this predicament.


That will not change, no. However, what I am about to share will give you a better understanding of the purpose behind W Corp.’s contract, and provide us with the possible means of finding the method by which we may complete it.


It is very likely that the entity behind the incidents on this train, and by extension, every incident of the same nature that has occurred in previous WARP train trips…


… is a Bloodfiend.


… Yes. I see that some Sinners may have encountered Bloodfiends in the past. A long-winded explanation seems unnecessary.


As many of you have stated thus far, the entities we faced in this train do not appear to be ‘Bloodfiends’.


In a sense, they are dreg-like beings that have failed to become Kindreds… they are referred to as ‘Bloodbags’ among relevant parties, according to information I am aware of.


As it has been said prior, it is impossible for passengers to disappear aboard WARP trains under normal circumstances.


Though our reserve of intelligence regarding the WARP trains or W Corp. is vast, if incomplete, we could not find a possible exception to the above rule.


Within that reserve of intelligence, however, I have discovered that inserting a previously unseen variable into the equation allows for a formulation of a new hypothesis.


A more accurate descriptor would be to say that they are either dissolved or vaporized.


No matter the degree of violence the passengers may indulge in, no matter how severe the damages may be, the WARP trains can revert them to their initial states at the beginning of the journey.


Among several interpretations of the word ‘violence’ involves cannibalization, of course.


However, as the passengers’ collective time itself is in moratorium for the duration of the train’s operation, digestion is not a biological process that should be active. In other words, even the devoured passengers could be reconstructed.


However, such is not true for ‘Bloodbags’. Bloodbags are, by their nature, obsessed with blood; their existence hinges on supplying themselves with the blood of their victims.


And it is said that they must consume a minuscule amount of blood to maintain their forms.


If I were to continue my deductions… perhaps ‘consumption of blood’, for Bloodfiends and Bloodbags is a fundamentally different process from our ‘consumption of nutrients’ for energy.


To them, blood is a culmination, an entailment of something that forms the self, including but not limited to: emotions, ambitions, wealth, purposes of existence… Then, it must naturally follow that they can spend their blood at will, which is a process that is isolated from other biological processes such as digestion.


… That information is inaccessible at the moment.


This is only a speculation, however… I assume that a form of direct physical contact is needed to turn an individual into a Bloodbag. If such were not the case, then we, who are likely the greatest obstacles to this entity’s goal at the moment, would have been the first ones to be turned.


Indeed. If we are to believe the words of the Fixer from earlier, then there is a high likelihood that the horde is advancing in this direction from the back of the train…


In other words, continuing down the train cars will lead us straight to the Bloodfiend.


… Dante.


My apologies. The access to that information is prohibited at this moment as well.


… I may have been too reliant on Faust. In too many places.


He has departed the scene.


I see. There are multiple possible interpretations depending on one’s perspective, despite the fact that there is but a single scene. I will remember both of your inputs.


Yes, well. Good for them.


I am physically unharmed, yet… Hm. Yes, I am alright.


However, I do not enjoy this circumstance which we find ourselves in. It is as though I am casting nets to nowhere while lost and isolated in a blind sea.


… I could usually complete these deductions within moments after establishing a few basic cross-references between the accessible information.


… Is that so.


Although this is not common knowledge, there is a subcategory of Fixers called Bloodfiend Hunters who specialize in… yes, hunting Bloodfiends.


Assuming that information is true, it can be inferred that Bloodfiends are difficult foes that require a certain expertise to defeat.


He… must be the Bloodfiend who caused this outbreak. He is our target.


Do not let your guard down, Heathcliff. This entity has managed to turn countless passengers of this train into his Bloodbags.


This is rather curious.


It appears that this Bloodfiend leaves this car only on rare occasions…


… Yet we have seen signs of his insidious influence throughout every car we have visited so far.


Bloodfiends…


… What if there was more than a single Bloodfiend on board, one still capable of rational thought…


Don Quixote, watch out!


Kindred…


Are you even aware of the exact nature of a ‘Kindred’?


I see. A Bloodfiend’s Kindred is like a sub-entity of the Bloodfiend, similar in concept to sub-entities created by Distortions or Abnormalities.


It must have been desperation that drove you to accept that proposition without hesitation, despite the lack of relevant information.


… It appears that he has empowered himself by reaping their blood.


Don Quixote! Stop her, now!


Dante…


I believed myself to be trying my utmost to overcome this adversity…


… without access to Faust’s knowledge and intelligence.


However…


With our loss of the Master Keycard… the uncertainty of this circumstance has greatly exacerbated.


At the origin of this plight…


… must be my overreliance on Faust.


Indeed, among many, I am a Faust that believes in uncertainty.


Our loss of the master keycard is but one of innumerable uncertain variables in the equation.


The constant is, however…


… that the Bloodfiend is just as desperate as we are.


Thus the only option that remains at present is to… compromise.


Very well. Then… Cassetti, why don’t we move this conversation to a different location?


Only I will accompany Dante to this negotiation. I will make my intentions clear now: Dante and I will not attack you there.


Yes. The freight car is immediately adjacent to this one; that is where we will further discuss what we each have to offer to one another.


Correct.


Dante… this will be my first attempt…


… at a ‘gamble’.


The connection has been restored.


Boarding Mephistopheles has… reestablished my connection to Faust.


No. And as I have stated before, this was a pure, incalculable gamble based on my own uncertain hypothesis.


This success helps me somewhat comprehend Miss Rodya’s fascination with gambling.


Now that the connection has been reestablished, I would like to make a complaint against the Fausts in the Gesellschaft management regarding the fact that they neglected to list the information pertaining to the loss of connection within the interiors of the WARP trains, however…


… finding a solution to this situation takes precedence. I have much reason to believe that their omission was done on purpose, but… I hope such is not the case.


… Let us discuss the details of our compromise. What are you willing to accept in return for the master keycard?


Like nothing happened…


Our memories and any signs of battle will be entirely erased upon our arrival. We will have no way to relay our news, whether one of success or failure.


If we had the means to defeat him, then at least W Corp. would inform us that our contract was successful after the fact. However…


… this current scenario will leave us with nothing to show for, not even the smallest hint, and the contract will end in failure.


However, what takes precedence over the contract is you and the Sinners’ psychological stability.


Certainly, you are aware that your suggestion is no solution at all, Don Quixote.


… Oh, I did not expect this to be the solution…


… According to this information I had viewed in the past, and once again just now, it’s…


Mm. … Dante. Take cover behind me and remain absolutely still.


And please, do note that the other Sinners must never hear a word of what is about to happ—


She appears to be in a state of deep slumber. As she is not at a risk of death, she will be waking up soon.


The master keycard is not an absolutely necessary element to resolving this situation.


It will require approximately five hours to formulate and proceed with an explanation in a manner that will allow the Sinners to fully comprehend the exact ‘how’ of this methodology. Therefore, it will be delivered to you in a digestible, summarized format.


We can utilize the Backdoor of Mephistopheles.


To put it simply, we will spend the time at a space disconnected from the train.


The train should be arriving at its destination in approximately ten seconds, going by the A Corp. time scale. All we must do is to remain somewhere in our original dimension for that duration.


Yes. This is the correct door. Its safety is completely ensured.


I… did not bother verifying that particular information myself.


It is necessary for future endeavors that I gain the experience… of encountering something completely unexpected.


Now, please enter through this door.


5… 4… 3… 2… 1…


We are employees of Limbus Company. We boarded the WARP train at the behest of your employer.


Yes, we must have suffered from a momentary, collective hallucination caused by fatigue. Very well, then. We will see ourselves out.


Understood. Any and all relevant reports will be sent to W Corp. via LCCA, and…


Because it was the preferable course of action to having the same explosive demise occur to your body instead.


I do find it regrettable that you were made to turn the clock despite my knowledge of the high likelihood of my death upon that occurrence.


… That is something I have been aware of since the LCB was first established. The same could be said of Vergilius.


However, it was by the will of the LCA’s superiors that this knowledge remains withheld from the Manager until the appropriate moment.


… According to my private judgment, yes.


Well, as my connection to all communications, including one to Faust, had been severed. I was not in a position to receive the headquarters’ authorization for that action.
